lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the central ribs with a slight increase in density near the shoulder transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4 posterior-most lines exhibit significant fragmentation, appearing as abbreviated segments or isolated circular blobs that do not connect to the dorsal midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch directly above the articulation of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A set of three spots aligns diagonally at a approximately 45-degree angle descending from the posterior torso towards the upper thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate curvature, projecting laterally and posteriorly from the frontal bone before curving medially and anteriorly at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.6 times the pixel diameter of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the distal 15% of the total horn length, sharply defined against the darker proximal spiral ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a continuous white dorsal crest of elongated hair extending from the neck to the base of the tail; prominent white chevron mark between the eyes.
